Gazi Mohammad Neamat Hossain, Advocate ------- For the Petitioners. 
Ramzan Ali Sikder Advocate ------- For the Opposite Party.
parties:
Dominous Pizza and others ------- Petitioners
Vs.
Domino's Pizza Inc  ------- Opposite Party.
full_judgment:
(a) A decree may kindly be passed in favour of the plaintiff and against the defendants declaring that the trade mark and business name 'Dominous Pizza', being used by the defendants, amounts to infringement of plaintiffs' trade mark 'Domino's Pizza' and that the defendants has no right, title or claims to use the said trade mark and/or business name of the plaintiff. 

 (b) A decree for permanent injunction may kindly be passed restraining the defend- ants whether itself or their men/women, employees, agents, partners, share holders or officers from using, preparing, storing, marketing, selling or offering for sale, passing off or attempting to pass off any goods bearing or under the trademark 'Dominous Pizza' or any other trade mark confusingly similar or identical to the trademark 'Domino's Pizza and Logo' of the plaintiff. 

 (c) A decree directing the defendants to deliver up to the plaintiff for destruction or defacement of all the products, menu cards, bill beaks and any other offending labels/packaging and other promotional! printed materials along with printing blocks, dyes, wrappers, plates, advertising material bearing the imitated trade mark 'Dominous' and any other trademark confusingly similar or identical to the trade mark 'Domino's Pizza & Logo' of the plaintiff. 

 (d)  A decree directing the defendants to furnish the complete accounts of the profit made during the period of infringement and also to direct the defendants to deposit the profit amount into the Court for the payment to the plaintiff.
